basic_info.description: An investor's dream in the heart of San Francisco! This 8-unit building in desirable Noe Valley offers an ideal blend of charm, convenience, and income potential. Each of the one-bedroom units is thoughtfully designed with spacious layouts and natural light. Six units are fully remodeled(kitchen, bath & flooring) and two are partially renovated. Residents enjoy easy access to popular local amenities, including cafes, boutiques, parks, and public transit options, making this property highly attractive to tenants.    A rare bonus in San Francisco, the property includes 8 dedicated parking spaces, one of which is a private garage perfect for additional income or for owner use. With the neighborhood's strong rental demand and the added convenience of parking, this property is a solid investment opportunity. Don't miss this chance to own a premium piece of Noe Valley real estate.
